fields.System.Title: INV-201 — Record a movement
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a developer, I want every stock change written to an append-only ledger, so that
any number can be explained and balances can always be rebuilt.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given any balance change, then a movement row is written in the same transaction.
  • - Given a movement, then it records from-location, to-location, product, batch, positive
  • quantity, type, reason code, reference, actor, timestamp, and correlation ID.
  • - Given a receipt, then the from-location is a virtual location, not null.
  • - Given a write-off, then the to-location is VIRT-LOSS, not null.
  • - Given any movement, then there is no code path that updates or deletes it.
  • - Given a correction is needed, then it is made by writing an opposite movement.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | inventory |
| Tables | stock_movement |
| Risks | Balance changed without a movement ([doc 09 §2.2](../../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md)) |
| Tests | unit · integration · invariant (ledger explains balance) |
